description: Automated scanning of code commits for embedded secrets (API keys, passwords, private keys, tokens, connection strings) using pattern-based and entropy-based detection. Runs as a git pre-commit hook or CI pipeline gate to prevent hard-coded credentials from reaching repositories where they can be harvested by attackers or leaked in public forks. Tools include gitleaks, trufflehog, and git-secrets. Complements credential rotation and vault-based secret management by catching secrets that bypass those controls at the source code layer.

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: Hard-coded credentials are detected and blocked before they reach the repository; the attacker must find credentials through an alternative channel (vault compromise, memory dump, network intercept) rather than simply reading source code or commit history

verification.method: Verify that a secrets scanning tool is configured as a git pre-commit hook or CI pipeline stage and reports no findings

commands.expected: Pre-commit hook exists and references a secrets scanning tool
